about: Real projects that the Code agent reads, read-only. Paths are relative to the folder that holds RootIQ. The incidents are simulated: their logs come from simulate_incident.py; the code is real.
cloud_code_note: true: Settings > Data sources > Code > Cloud models is on, so Groq or Gemini read the code of these projects and write the patches (secrets in the code are masked; .env files are never read). false or --local-code: only the local model reads the code.

open.title: Trial screening estimate fails for the CKD study
open.reported_issue: Since this morning the Estimate and Screen steps of trial NCT06742723 (baxdrostat in CKD) fail with a server error for the study coordinators. The diabetes trial still works.

open.title: Support tickets fall back to manual triage after the model update
open.reported_issue: Since today's TriageLM model update, long support tickets come back without a routing decision and land in the manual queue. Short tickets still work.

resolved.title: HbA1c criteria missed patients with results in mmol/mol
resolved.reported_issue: Patients with HbA1c reported in mmol/mol were never matched to the diabetes trial, which states HbA1c in percent.
resolved.cause: The rules engine compared the raw value with the criterion. A result of 64 mmol/mol is 8.0 %, but the engine read 64.
resolved.workaround: Coordinators converted the values by hand.
resolved.resolution: Added the mmol/mol to % conversion to units.py and converted each lab value to the criterion's unit before the comparison.
preventive_actions: A test for each unit pair in units.py
Show the converted and the original value in the evidence

resolved.title: Fine-tuned triage model wrapped its JSON in Markdown
resolved.reported_issue: Some triage results came back as json_ok=false although the model output looked right.
resolved.cause: The model sometimes put the JSON inside a Markdown code fence, and json.loads failed on the fence.
resolved.resolution: The parser now falls back to the text between the first { and the last } (eval/parse.py).
preventive_actions: A parse test with fenced output
Track json_ok in the evaluation report

resolved.title: Weight trend showed pounds as kilograms
resolved.reported_issue: After switching to imperial units, my weight trend jumped from 80 to 176.
resolved.cause: Weights typed in pounds were saved without conversion to kilograms.
resolved.workaround: Switch back to metric before logging.
resolved.resolution: Weights are converted with toKg in lib/nutrition.ts before they are saved.
preventive_actions: A unit test for toKg and toDisplayWeight

resolved.title: Weekly check-in told users who skip logging days to eat 1,200 kcal
resolved.reported_issue: My weekly check-in says my TDEE is about 1,390 and recommends 1,200 kcal for my cut. I eat around 2,400 kcal on the days I log, but I only log 4 days a week.
resolved.cause: averageCalories in lib/nutrition.ts counted each day with no food log as 0 kcal, so the 7-day intake average and the estimated TDEE were far too low.
resolved.workaround: Log food every day of the week.
resolved.resolution: averageCalories and adherenceScore now use logged days only. The check-in needs 3 logged days and 2 weigh-ins in the last 7 days, and the weight trend is a weekly rate.
preventive_actions: A test for a week with skipped logging days
Treat missing data as unknown, not as zero

jira_keep_note: Jira tickets that stay open as demo cases, one edge case each: KAN-18 personal data in a ticket (masking), KAN-19 model routing, KAN-6 critical double charge (a look-alike past incident), KAN-8 staging, not production, KAN-4 and KAN-20 one cause in two services (related incidents). prepare_demo imports them again with a fresh SLA. Close the other tickets in Jira, or a sync imports them.
